text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My shoelaces're tied nice 'n tight, and I've even had my apple juice!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I trained hard for this, so I'm pos'tive I can win!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yep. I've done about all I can! Hm. Unless maybe I missed someth'n…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-right! Gotta stay cool as a cucumber!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, but I can't be relax'n on the track! After all, first place's the only place for me!
